document_title: DCO-1 and LCOR-1 Tariffs - compliance filing made under the 2025 IRP Order Adopting Stipulation (dockets 56002 and 56003)
how_obtained: Fetched the GA PSC FACTS document-detail page /search/facts-document/?documentId=224109 to read its download link, then downloaded the ZIP 'dkt_56002_56003_dco-1_and_lcor-1_tariffs.zip' from the public API endpoint https://services.psc.ga.gov/api/v1/External/Public/Get/Document/DownloadFile/224109/105404. Unzipped it and took only 'DKT 56002 & 56003 DCO-1 and LCOR-1 Tariffs.pdf'. Converted the PDF to text with pdfminer.six extract_text(). Saved exactly as pdfminer emitted it - no reflow, no de-hyphenation, no ligature or soft-hyphen repair; running heads, marginal line-number columns, dot leaders and form feeds all left in place.
